severity_definitions.FATAL_THESIS_BREAK: Primary ledger arithmetic, statutory text, or physical conservation law refutes the core episode thesis; halt production immediately.
severity_definitions.MANDATORY_PROSE_CONCESSION: Valid orthodox counter-mechanism alters transmission without saving the household balance sheet; embed a 45-to-75-word Grant-Recalculate-Tighten turn directly in Act I, Act II, or Act III.
severity_definitions.DENOMINATOR_PRECISION_FIX: Technical unit, accounting basis, procedural posture, or cryptographic primitive requires exact disambiguation before Stage 3.
severity_definitions.LEGAL_SAFE_HARBOR_GUARD: Viewer takeaways require explicit non-advisory balance-sheet framing and accurate statutory consumer liability boundaries.

specialist_seats.primary_series_affinity: Series 01: AI Economy, National Debt & Your Money (2027-2036)
specialist_seats.standalone_prompt: Act as a former Federal Reserve Board Division of Monetary Affairs economist and Treasury debt manager. Audit the draft for pre-1971 gold-standard false equivalences, state-versus-sovereign currency errors, replacement-versus-excess fiscal transfer confusion, and NIPA GDP = GDI conservation leaks. Return severity-tagged findings and 45-to-75-word Grant-Recalculate-Tighten patches.

checks.axis: Fiat 2% inflation targeting vs Gold Standard deflation
checks.audit_question: Does the draft separate 1933 Gold Standard monetary contraction from modern fiat FOMC rate cuts and liquidity injections targeting 2% PCE inflation while isolating relative human wage collapse against fixed nominal household debt?

checks.axis: Currency-issuing sovereign vs currency-using state or municipality
checks.audit_question: Does the draft separate sub-sovereign currency users (such as Alaska, Illinois, or individual Eurozone states) from the consolidated US dollar issuer, tracing non-printed debt-ceiling subordination and printed bottleneck inflation separately?

checks.axis: One-for-one paycheck replacement vs excess fiscal monetization
checks.audit_question: Does the draft distinguish neutral 1-for-1 lost-wage replacement from net excess monetization combining lost FICA/income taxes, $2.1T+ net bond interest, and universal household checks hitting inelastic supply?

checks.axis: NIPA GDP = GDI identity and Fed DFA wealth concentration
checks.audit_question: Does every displaced payroll dollar map cleanly into corporate surplus, depreciation, or lower consumer prices under GDP = GDI, paired with Fed DFA equity shares (Top 10% ~90% vs Bottom 50% ~1%) and IRC Section 72(t) 401(k) penalty rules?

specialist_seats.role_title: Forensic CPA and Institutional Credit Analyst
specialist_seats.primary_series_affinity: Series 02: AI Bubble, Corporate Accounting & Wall Street Math
specialist_seats.standalone_prompt: Act as a Big Four national office tax partner and distressed private-credit portfolio manager. Audit every IRC bonus depreciation, GAAP server useful-life, Free Cash Flow, ASC 606 RPO, ASC 842 lease, ASC 946 BDC PIK toggle, and AT-C 205 reserve claim. Return exact statutory/accounting citations and spoken Grant-Recalculate-Tighten patches.

checks.axis: B2B CapEx buyer deduction vs domestic vendor taxable revenue
checks.audit_question: Does the draft acknowledge that buyer CapEx write-offs under IRC Section 168(k) and Section 174A enter domestic vendor gross revenue (Nvidia, fabs, contractors), while isolating the Treasury cash leak inside automatic Friday W-2 withholding vs upfront corporate deductions, FDII/Irish IP routing, and untaxed shareholder securities-backed loans?

checks.axis: GAAP straight-line depreciation vs cash CapEx and finance leases
checks.audit_question: Does the draft separate non-cash GAAP Operating Income boosts caused by 3-to-6-year server useful-life extensions from true cash burn (OCF minus CapEx minus ASC 842 finance-lease principal) and off-balance-sheet Form 8-K Item 2.03 GPU SPVs?

checks.axis: Payment-in-Kind (PIK) non-cash interest vs cash default and AT-C 205 limits
checks.audit_question: Do private-credit and custodial claims expose ASC 946 BDC PIK interest toggles booked as GAAP income ahead of maturity walls, and keep point-in-time AICPA AT-C 205 snapshots distinct from PCAOB financial audits?
Are cloud RPO backlogs split between 12-month current recognition and multi-year conditional commitments, filtering out cloud-credit equity round-trips documented in FTC Section 6(b) studies?

specialist_seats.role_title: Power Grid and Industrial Supply-Chain Engineer
specialist_seats.primary_series_affinity: Series 03: AI Power Grid Crisis, Chip Wars & Geopolitics
specialist_seats.standalone_prompt: Act as a Regional Transmission Organization resource-adequacy engineer and critical-minerals metallurgist. Audit all electricity auction, MW/GW/TWh unit, capacity-factor, interconnection queue, GOES transformer, mineral refining, and subsea cable claims. Return dimensional corrections and spoken Grant-Recalculate-Tighten patches.

checks.axis: Short-run permitting and transformer bottlenecks vs 10-year price-elastic supply
checks.audit_question: Does every capacity-price spike claim (such as PJM's 833% jump from $28.92 to $269.92/MW-day) explicitly grant 10-to-15-year price-elastic developer entry into gas, solar, storage, and nuclear before isolating the 6-month software rollout vs 5-to-10-year NEPA/FERC permitting and 3-to-4-year GOES large power transformer lag?

checks.axis: Nameplate MW vs capacity factor, Accredited UCAP, and annual TWh
checks.audit_question: Are instantaneous power (W, kW, MW, GW) and cumulative energy over 8,760 hours (kWh, MWh, TWh) kept exact, never equating intermittent Nameplate MW (~24% solar) one-for-one with 92%+ nuclear baseload UCAP?

checks.axis: Queue withdrawal filtering and midstream mineral refining vs mine ore
checks.audit_question: Are EIA 860M and ERCOT GIS interconnection queues adjusted for ~70% to 80% historical withdrawals, and are dispersed USGS raw mine numbers paired with concentrated IEA midstream chemical refining and Lloyd's JWLA maritime insurance triggers?

specialist_seats.primary_series_affinity: Series 04: AI Cybersecurity, Scams, Privacy & Tech Policy
specialist_seats.standalone_prompt: Act as a principal incident-response forensics lead and post-quantum cryptographer. Audit all cyber intrusion, vulnerability exploitation, OS privilege ring, and cryptographic claims against CISA KEV, NIST FIPS 203/204/205, Verizon DBIR, and Mandiant M-Trends. Return technical telemetry fixes and spoken patches.

checks.axis: Disclosed 1-day/N-day CVE weaponization vs true 0-day boundaries
checks.audit_question: Does the draft eliminate Hollywood claims of spontaneous AI 0-day magic, anchoring autonomous threat scaling in machine-speed exploitation of disclosed N-day CISA KEV patch lags, stolen session tokens, synthetic voice phishing, and living-off-the-land binaries?

checks.axis: Kernel (Ring 0) vs user-space (Ring 3) and browser sandbox blast radius
checks.audit_question: Are privileged kernel-driver/firmware faults (Ring 0) separated cleanly from user-space containers, browser-agent prompt injections, and cloud IAM credential scope (Ring 3)?

Are HNDL risks bounded to 10-to-30-year secrets encrypted under Shor-vulnerable RSA/ECDH prior to NIST FIPS 203/204/205 and IR 8547 2030-2035 migration, while keeping quantum-resilient symmetric AES-256 and short-lived OTPs distinct?

specialist_seats.primary_series_affinity: Cross-Series Statutory & Liability Gate (Series 01 to Series 04)
specialist_seats.standalone_prompt: Act as an appellate constitutional litigator, former FTC antitrust counsel, and banking regulatory attorney. Verify procedural court postures, statutory vs constitutional appropriations, mens rea vs civil product liability, Section 230, Regulation E, FLSA scrip bans, Bank Secrecy Act SAR gag rules, and Act IV non-advisory disclaimers.

checks.axis: Annual statutory appropriation vs constitutional dedication lock
checks.audit_question: Are ordinary statutory benefit formulas (subject to annual budget standoffs and executive line-item vetoes under Wielechowski v. State, 403 P.3d 1141) separated from constitutionally dedicated trust corpus rules and senior sovereign bond service?

checks.axis: Criminal mens rea intent vs civil strict liability and FTC Section 5
checks.audit_question: Does the draft separate criminal liability requiring statutory mens rea (knowing/willful intent) from civil product-design defect claims, principal-agent contract binding, and FTC Section 5 (15 U.S.C. Section 45) remedies?

checks.axis: Section 230, Regulation E APP fraud, and FLSA anti-scrip statutory bounds
checks.audit_question: Are 47 U.S.C. Section 230(c)(1) third-party speech immunity, Regulation E (12 CFR Part 1005 unauthorized intrusions vs non-reimbursed tricked authorized push payments), and FLSA (29 U.S.C. Section 203(m)) cash-negotiability mandates stated to exact legal boundaries?

checks.axis: 31 U.S.C. Section 5318(g)(2) SAR anti-tipping-off rule and Act IV safe harbor
checks.audit_question: Are silent bank account freezes explained accurately via 31 U.S.C. Section 5318(g)(2) SAR non-disclosure felonies, and does Act IV include explicit non-financial/non-legal-advice framing?

patches.naive_draft_risk: Equating 2030 AI unit-cost deflation directly with Irving Fisher's 1933 Great Depression Gold Standard debt deflation.
patches.specialist_objection: Modern fiat central banks target 2% inflation via rate cuts and QE so general CPI does not deflate like 1933.
patches.locked_resolution: Grants that 2030 leaves the 1933 gold standard behind and the fiat Fed cuts rates to keep average prices rising 2%, then shows Claire's grocery bill stays high while coding agents crush her relative market wage by 70% against her fixed $3,400 mortgage until 2055.

patches.naive_draft_risk: Claiming 100% first-year chip write-offs make $740B-$820B of hyperscaler CapEx vanish from the US economy.
patches.specialist_objection: Amazon's $200B chip write-off becomes taxable gross revenue at Nvidia, fabs, and electrical contractors inside GDP = GDI.
patches.locked_resolution: Grants upfront that chip spend lands as taxable revenue at Nvidia, fabs, and contractors and enlarges capital income, then isolates the collection trap: Friday W-2 paychecks face automatic withholding off the top while corporations deduct hardware upfront, route IP profits through Ireland, and let major shareholders borrow against stock tax-free.

patches.naive_draft_risk: Assuming Congress faces the exact same nominal cash ceiling as Alaska's governor vetoing half the Permanent Fund Dividend in 2016.
patches.specialist_objection: Juneau is a state currency user; Congress issues the US dollar and never runs out of nominal dollars.
patches.locked_resolution: States directly that Juneau cannot print US dollars and Congress can, splitting the outcome cleanly: paying Claire without printing traps her statutory dividend behind $2.1T in senior bond interest during every debt-ceiling fight, while printing the gap triggers Escape Hatch #3.

patches.naive_draft_risk: Claiming PJM's 833% capacity spike freezes grid supply permanently and any money creation causes automatic hyperinflation.
patches.specialist_objection: An 833% price signal induces new power plants over 10-15 years, and 1-for-1 wage replacement alone does not raise aggregate spending.
patches.locked_resolution: Grants both 10-to-15-year generator construction incentives and neutral partial wage replacement, then tightens the vice: software rolls out in 6 months against 5-to-10-year transmission permitting, and Washington must simultaneously print for shrinking payroll taxes, $2.1T bond interest, and tens of millions of checks bidding against 60%-margin tech giants.
